title: cosys: packages and Lean 4 proofs for Collaboration Is Composition
description: The packages that implement a model of collaboration in which every party acts through a Mealy machine over an append-only log of signed records, and the Lean 4 proofs of the paper Collaboration Is Composition: Mealy Machines over Signed Records in Poly and Org. The proofs are in proofs/; proofs/Check.lean prints the axioms behind each result.
